title: Horry County Loan Limits 2026: FHA, Conforming and VA
description: 2026 loan limits in Horry County and Myrtle Beach: the conforming limit, the FHA limit, VA loans with full entitlement, and your options above the limit.
h1: Horry County Loan Limits for 2026: FHA, Conforming, VA and Jumbo
dek: How much you can borrow with each loan type in Myrtle Beach and the Grand Strand, and what to do if your loan is over the limit.

faq.q: What is the FHA loan limit in Horry County for 2026?
faq.a: The 2026 FHA limit for a one-unit home in Horry County is $541,287, the national minimum.

faq.q: What is the conforming loan limit in Myrtle Beach?
faq.a: For 2026, it's $832,750 for a one-unit home in Horry County, including Myrtle Beach. Anything larger needs a jumbo loan.

faq.q: Is there a VA loan limit in Horry County?
faq.a: VA sets none for borrowers with their full entitlement. With part of it tied up in another VA loan, the county's $832,750 conforming limit decides how much of a new loan VA will guarantee.

faq.q: Can I buy a house above the FHA limit with an FHA loan?
faq.a: Yes. The limit applies to the loan, not the price, so a bigger down payment can keep the loan at or under $541,287.
